questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the following sentence in passive voice.
He had cleaned the bathroom
options: 1) The bathroom had been cleaned by him.
2) The bathroom had cleaned by him.
3) The bathroom has cleaned by him.
4) The bathroom has been cleaned by him.
questions.solution: A) The bathroom had been cleaned by him.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly expresses the given sentence in passive voice.
Why didn’t she bring her son to my house?
options: 1) Why isn’t her son brought by you to my house?
2) Why wasn’t her son brought to my house?
3) Why isn’t her son brought to my house?
4) Why wasn’t her son brought by her to my house?
questions.solution: D)Why wasn’t her son brought by her to my house?

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.
We should clean the house regularly
options: 1) The house should be clean regularly by us.
2) The house should have been cleaned regularly by us.
3) The house should be cleaned regularly by us.
4) The house should be being cleaned regularly by us.
questions.solution: C) The house should be cleaned regularly by us.

questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

options: 1) The kind nurse bandages his father’s arm.
2) The kind nurse had bandaged his father’s arm.
3) The kind nurse has bandaged his father’s arm.
4) The kind nurse bandaged his father’s arm.
questions.solution: D) The kind nurse bandaged his father’s arm.

questions.question:
